text:
Mira Chen: Hey team — PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4832. Fixes a race in the serve loop that could drop a KV-cache flush. I addressed the earlier review comments, added a focused unit test, and updated the changelog. PTAL when you have a sec. cc @Devin Park @Samir Patel

Devin Park: quick q — did you measure perf impact from the extra lock? we need to know if this affects p50 under our trace load.

Mira Chen: good call. ran the microbenchmark we discussed (local trace replay). p50 change <1%, p99 unchanged. I added the bench output and a short note in the PR description.

Samir Patel: left two tiny nits inline: typo in the comment near kv_flush() and missing newline in the new test file. also can you expand the changelog line to explicitly mention the behavior under heavy concurrent writes? helps ops triage. otherwise looks solid.

Mira Chen: thanks — fixed the typo, added newline, and expanded the changelog to call out the concurrent-writes behavior. pushed a new commit (force-pushed to keep history tidy). PTAL again.

Henry K: if CI is green, can we merge before EOD? want this in the canary deploy tomorrow morning.

CI Bot: build • ubuntu-latest — passed
CI Bot: unit-tests — 48 passed, 2 skipped
CI Bot: integration-smoke — passed

Devin Park: cheers, looks good from my side. approved.

Samir Patel: LGTM. :thumbsup:

Mira Chen: thanks all — merging now. will watch canary rollout and post an update in #incidents if anything odd pops up.

Devin Park: thanks Mira — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Samir Patel: nice one.

Mira Chen: ps: test command I used for the new unit was:
```
pytest tests/test_kvflush.py::test_concurrent_flush -q
```
added to PR description for reproducibility.

Henry K: noted — thanks for the bench numbers in the PR. :rocket:
